I extracted 150 frames from Nr4fQstqHDM.mp4 at t=428 and 120 from zFtCaTO0_1M.mp4 at t=900 with '-fps_mode passthrough' and computed luma MAE on [400:1000, 500:1500]. Nr4f mod-4 means = [0.061, 3.076, 0.026, 0.069] and raw deltas 0.42 5.94 0.05 0.02 0.02 5.29 0.02 0.02 0.03 4.95 0.00 0.03 0.00 3.17 - identical to the claim to three decimals. zFt mod-4 = [0.003, 0.040, 6.438, 0.078] - also identical. So the videos deliver unique content on exactly every 4th 60 fps frame. What that proves is that the VIDEO's temporal resolution is 15.0 Hz, not that the game steps poses at 15 Hz: a 15 fps capture of a 24 Hz game produces a bit-identical signature, and the fact that phases 0/2/3 sit at 0.003-0.078 MAE (NOTHING changes between updates - not parallax, not particles, not the HUD) is the signature of a 15 fps SOURCE rather than of a 24 Hz renderer with a pose latch. The final clause, 'the SWF's declared 24 fps describes only the stage timeline', is contradicted by the code I read: AnimData durations are integer stage-frame ticks, MCSCharacter.as:1315 advances frameCounter once per updateAnimation, the AnimData tails are multiples of 6 and 24, and 896 animdata frames deliberately carry no node updates on alternating indices - 12 Hz content inside a 24 Hz clock, which is impossible to author against a 15 Hz clock. Both payload headers independently read 24.0. The frame does not DISAGREE with the byte here; it under-samples it, so the frame-wins invariant does not fire. The honest verdict on 'does the shipped game step poses at 15 Hz' is STILL_UNHELD.

new_findings.text: The build-parity hole on the whole canvas/letterbox contract is CLOSED from the web side. reference/decompiled/shs3_payload/scripts/§1t1540s0§.as:269-320 is the web v0.717 payload's own resize handler and it declares :271 _loc2_=800, :272 _loc3_=480, :273 _loc4_=690, then the identical '<=' with-bar aspect test, the identical fit-width/fit-height branch with the same centring offsets, and publishes the same six stage values that InputManager reads back. 800x480 base + a 210px bar is a WEB fact, not an Android inference.
new_findings.lane_impact: L-ui-hud / L-render: HUD x-fraction re-basing on 800x480 is now legitimate for the web build. Kills the 'every canvas constant is Mobile-only' caveat.

new_findings.text: THE EQUIPMENT-ART BLOCKER IS DEAD. 115_Mobile_SHS3Resource.bin decrypts with ResourceManager.decryptByteArray at key 'shs3resource.swf'.charCodeAt(1) = 'h' = 104 and inflates to a 1,040,849-byte CWS v17 SWF. Its SymbolClass/ExportAssets tables name 1,912 exported symbols: 151 torso / 151 lowarm / 151 uparm / 151 pelvic / 150 stomach / 112 item / 109 weapon / 96 hat / 85 calf / 85 crotch / 85 thigh / 79 skill / 73 hair / 60 prop / 59 mask / 44 foot / 44 foottop / 38 head / 33 hand / 33 neck / 8 acc / 5 achievement, plus complete bear, boar, deer, horse and wolf part sets. The roster art has been in the repo the whole time.
new_findings.quote: ResourceManager.as:200 `internal static function decryptByteArray(source:ByteArray, key:int) : ByteArray` :205 `for(var i:int = 3; i < 256; i++)` :207 `if(i % 11 == 0)` :213 `ba[i] ^= key;` · Mobile.as:50 `internal static const SHS3Resource:Class = Mobile_SHS3Resource;` :330 `this.processResource(ByteArray(new SHS3Resource()),resourceIndex);` · decoded: 1,912 exported symbols incl. hair6000, calf11000, hat7000, mask9000, acc3000-3008
new_findings.lane_impact: L6 art + L3 items-equipment: overturns art-anim/equipment-art-was-server-streamed's residual blocker. Equipment art must NOT be authored from frames; it must be transcribed from this SWF.

new_findings.text: Stage-0 C1's 'key m=109' is one of FIVE keys, and the transform is not a plain XOR. ResourceManager.as:186 and Mobile.as:352 both pass resourceFileNameArray[n].charCodeAt(1), so: 115_SHS3Resource = 'h' = 104, 113_MusicResource = 'u' = 117, 122_SoundResource = 'o' = 111, 124_ImageResource = 'm' = 109, 120_BGResource = 'g' = 103. The transform itself (ResourceManager.as:205-214) touches only bytes 3..255 and, when i%11==0, first SWAPS ba[i] with ba[i+256]. I decrypted all five: every one yields CWS\x11 and inflates (image 1,908,229 B, bg 4,412,340 B, shs3 1,040,849 B, sound 29,623 B, music 1,402,677 B).
new_findings.cite: reference/decompiled/shs3_android/scripts/ResourceManager.as:41,:186,:200-217 + Mobile.as:352; all five blobs under reference/extracted/android/ decrypted and inflated by me
new_findings.quote: ResourceManager.as:41 `internal static var resourceFileNameArray:Array = ["shs3resource.swf","musicresource.swf","soundresource.swf","imageresource.swf","bgresource.swf"];` · :186 `ba = decryptByteArray(ba,resourceFileNameArray[num].charCodeAt(1));` · :209-211 `temp = int(ba[i]); ba[i] = ba[i + 256]; ba[i + 256] = temp;`
new_findings.lane_impact: Method, all lanes: anyone re-deriving from the blobs with a single key 109 will silently fail on four of the five and re-report them as unrecoverable - which is exactly how the equipment-art blocker was invented.

new_findings.text: Every screen-shake number in this lane is being read in the wrong slot. StageManager.as:1200 declares `public static function startShake(shakeDuration:int, shakeAmt:int = 30)`, so the single-argument call sites - startShake(12) at MCSPlayer.as:911 and :4180 and HeavenlySwordProjectile.as:76, startShake(24) at MCSPlayer.as:946, startShake(6) at Trap_CrusherBlockAuto.as:88 and Trap_CrusherColumnAuto.as:90, startShake(val) at StatsManager.as:3535 - all set DURATION IN TICKS and inherit amplitude 30. The only data-driven amplitude in the game is Marker_RumbleTrigger.as:44 `StageManager.startShake(this.shakeDuration,this.shakeAmt)`.
new_findings.cite: reference/decompiled/shs3_android/scripts/StageManager.as:1200-1206 + Marker_RumbleTrigger.as:44 + my grep of all 8 startShake( call sites
new_findings.quote: StageManager.as:1200 `public static function startShake(shakeDuration:int, shakeAmt:int = 30) : *` :1203 `screenShakeCounter = shakeDuration;` :1204 `screenShakeAmt = shakeAmt;` · Marker_RumbleTrigger.as:44 `StageManager.startShake(this.shakeDuration,this.shakeAmt);`
new_findings.lane_impact: L6 art-anim: a rebuild that ships 'crusher trap shakes at amplitude 6' will be wrong twice over - wrong axis and wrong default. The shake API needs (durationTicks, amplitude=30).

new_findings.text: The ground plane is not the only plane with a per-layer blur exception. BG_Loader.as:186 wraps the farthest-plane blur in `if(!(this.bgType == BG_FORESTSPOOKY && i > 2))`, so BG_ForestSpooky's farthest layers 3 and 4 render sharp. Separately, FIVE bgdata records carry gcount=4, not four: id 6 BG_ForestSpooky, 32 BG_Graveyard, 48 BG_TempleExteriorFog, 49 BG_TempleRuinsFog, 51 BG_DungeonFog.
new_findings.quote: BG_Loader.as:186 `if(!(this.bgType == BG_FORESTSPOOKY && i > 2))` 188 `if(farthestLayerBlur != 0)` 190 `ColorCode.blur(mc,farthestLayerBlur);` · gcount histogram over 49 records = {2:34, 0:6, 4:5, 1:4}
new_findings.lane_impact: L6 art-anim: bounds android-blobs/ground-blur-applies-to-two-layers-only. The depth-of-field rule is per-plane AND per-background, not a single ladder with one exception.

new_findings.text: The 7-way human death dice is the LAST of five branches in NPC.die(), and the four ahead of it are unheld by any claim in this packet. NPC.as:909-913 returns bare dead=true from GOTLAUNCHED_STATE with no animation at all; :914-925 handles isDowned() with DEATHDOWNED plus a 90-degree torso emitter at variance 15; :926-954 handles SEPPUKU_START, splitting into SEPPUKU_MID or, when behead is set and censorship is off, SEPPUKU_NOHEAD with its own 3-way emitter dice over PART_neck at 130 degrees and the detached head at 180; and :1084+ handles a plain behead. Only if none of those fire does :1005 roll Math.random()*7.
new_findings.quote: NPC.as:909 `if(actionState == GOTLAUNCHED_STATE) { dead = true; return; }` · :914 `if(this.isDowned())` :917 `startAnim(DEATHDOWNED);` · :926 `if(mcs.animation == SEPPUKU_START)` :939 `startAnim(SEPPUKU_NOHEAD);` :941 `dice = Math.random() * 3;` · :1005 `dice = Math.random() * 7;`
new_findings.lane_impact: L2 enemies-ai + L6 art-anim: a rebuild wiring only the 7-way dice loses the launched, downed and seppuku deaths entirely, and StatsManager.censored gates the emitters on every one of them.
